verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS incident-management platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a first-party Rootly command-line tool. The 'Gemini CLI' and 'Claude Code' mentions refer to third-party MCP clients. '/rootly summary' is a Slack slash command. The API, OpenAPI spec and MCP server are separate capabilities or developer building blocks, so none of these count as a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
